pages.text: Tiers 5-8 are $(l)Fabricators$(): multiblock machines built from a square base of $(item)Printer Casing$() with a controller block in the center. They print bigger, faster, and cheaper than any single-block printer.$(br2)$(li)$(l)T5$() — 3×3 base$(li)$(l)T6$() — 5×5 base$(li)$(l)T7$() — 7×7 base$(li)$(l)T8$() — 9×9 base
$(item)Printer Casing$() — the building block of every Fabricator base. One craft yields $(l)four$(); a T5 needs 4 (plus 4 Diamond Block corners), a T8 needs 76 (plus 4 Awakened Draconium corners).
The $(item)Tier 5 Fabricator$() controller, built around a Tier 4 printer and $(item)Printite Crystal$().

pages.title: Forming & Collapsing
pages.text: Lay the base, place the controller in the center, and $(l)right-click the controller$() to form the machine — the casing lights up. See the $(l)Build Walkthrough$() for the layouts.$(br2)Breaking a $(l)formed$() controller collapses the whole machine back into a $(l)single item$() that re-forms, fully intact, when re-placed. Move a Fabricator without rebuilding it.

pages.title: Tier 8: Draconic
pages.text: The $(item)Tier 8 Fabricator$() is the endgame. It requires $(l)Draconic Evolution$() to be installed, and its four base corners must be $(l)Awakened Draconium$() blocks instead of casing. Without Draconic Evolution it refuses to form.
